digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics command and passive instrumentation
propositions: Rebar has rich event-sourced history but no aggregation layer to surface agent-loop and code-health trends over time across date ranges.

Three tier-C blindspots (env/integration-diagnosis intervals, bug provenance, bug outcome classification) leave no durable trace in the event store and require passive instrumentation to capture structurally.

Bug provenance via caused_by link relations must be auto-derived from blame (pre-fix state over file_impact) with best-effort non-authoritative confidence and explicit override support, bypassing closed-source guards for already-closed bugs.
Bug-close workflow must transition from free-text required --reason to bounded required --class enum (no net increase in required arguments), persisted on STATUS events and never auto-derived.

Metric snapshots must be committed to git-tracked .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson (not gitignored reports/) and all registered metrics must appear in date-range output with either values or unavailable/accruing_since states.

Backfilled or classified metrics must be universally labeled source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified, never aggregated into authoritative structural series, with is_authoritative() returning False for such data.
